Each source profile is searched clean, rotated 24°, and re-margined against a 12000-profile index. The highlighted tile is the correct profile; the badge shows the rank each side gave it. Live = the production ProfileMatcher (HOG + 24-rotation sweep). Gated (B) = canon_dt/global pool + ORB rescore, gate ratio 1.05. The route tag shows which path B took per query.
